newsitem.title: USA: WICOR unit to acquire lighting line.
newsitem.headline: WICOR unit to acquire lighting line.

text.p: WICOR Inc, an energy services and pump manufacturing company, said Monday its Sta-Rite Industries unit signed an agreement to buy a line of swimming pool and spa lighting equipment made by Hydrel, a division of California-based GTY Industries.
The cash transaction is expected to close in early August, WICOR said.

"The addition of this high-quality line of lighting products will round out Sta-Rite's offerings for the pool and spa industry, enabling us to offer a full range of equipment to our customers, from pumps and filters to cleaners, heaters and lights," WICOR chief executive George Wardeberg said in a news release.
WICOR shares were down 1/2 at 39-1/4 Monday.
